title: ParkSmart: Mall Parking Occupancy
context: Malls show free-space counts at the entrance and charge by the hour. Sensors log every entry and exit.
input: Entries/exits with times and plates; slot grid (levels × slots) as a 2-D array.

milestones.title: Re-entry without exit
milestones.requirement: Plates seen entering twice without an exit (count array over plate ids).

milestones.title: Routes to a free slot
milestones.requirement: Count right/down routes through the lot grid avoiding blocked cells (memo DP).

milestones.title: Free slots in a zone
milestones.requirement: 2-D prefix sums over the slot grid answer 'free slots in this block' in O(1).

milestones.title: EV charger bookings
milestones.requirement: Most non-overlapping bookings one charger can serve (activity selection).

milestones.title: Fee slab lookup
milestones.requirement: Fee slab for a stay length with a lower bound on slab boundaries.

milestones.title: Entry gate queue
milestones.requirement: Cars queue at the boom barrier; compare 1 and 2 gates.
